geography: D.nodes, D.geo and D.nodeScenery; illustrative roadside environments, not surveyed road views. Fictional locations retain game descriptions.

busan.brief: Gamcheon harbor in Busan: sheltered inlet below densely built steep Korean hills, container cranes and worn coastal warehouses, dark seawater, no inland stadium.

gimhae.brief: Gimhae's broad low-lying plain, overgrown disused small civilian airfield runway and low hangars, distant low ridges, rice fields.

yangsan.brief: Yangsan valley skyline and wooded rounded hills, worn apartments and low-rise roofs, same approved seed composition.

miryang.brief: Miryang rural valley: old low-rise market roofs, subdued canvas market awnings, orchard rows and paddies, rounded wooded ridges, no large modern skyline.

jinju.brief: Jinju Namgang riverside, broad calm river and a partly broken low concrete bridge, old town roofs behind trees, weathered unlit lantern frames by the bank.

hapcheon.brief: Hapcheon apple orchard in a green inland valley: irregular orchard rows, farm sheds and wooded mountain foothills, no city skyline.

geochang.brief: Geochang basin encircled by layered forested mountains, a small weathered town among cultivated plots in the valley.

daegu.brief: Daegu inland basin: distant large low domed baseball stadium repurposed as a covered market (fictional game landmark), weathered apartment clusters and broad foothills. Dome below skyline midpoint, no Seoul tower or sea.

gumi.brief: Gumi industrial district on inland plain: long factories with sawtooth roofs, idle chimneys, cooling infrastructure, mountain ridge behind. No coastal cranes or sea.

gimcheon.brief: Gimcheon inland transport junction: layered weathered concrete highway ramps and rail freight sheds, patches of fields between low hills, empty signboards with no letters.

muju.brief: Muju wooded mountain valley: dark road tunnel mouth set into forested rock, small improvised shelters tucked outside its portal. No large city.

namwon.brief: Namwon: weathered traditional Korean open pavilion and tiled roofs beside a quiet riverbank, low town and forested ridge.

jeonju.brief: Jeonju western market edge: dense low Korean shop roofs and traditional tiled rooftops, small canvas awnings, distant modest hills. No pagodas or palaces.

yeongdong.brief: Yeongdong inland vineyard slopes: rows of weathered grape trellises overgrown with vines, small farm sheds, enclosing forested hills.

daejeon.brief: Daejeon research campus: weathered low laboratory buildings, small dish antenna and institutional blocks among pines, mountain ridges, no giant space launch tower.

nonsan.brief: Nonsan broad agricultural plain: paddies and narrow irrigation channels, small farm compounds, sparse trees and distant low horizon; no towering mountains.

gongju.brief: Gongju: wooded river bluff carrying weathered Korean stone fortress walls, broad river with low bridge piers, traditional roofs near wall.

cheongju.brief: Cheongju: inland provincial broadcasting complex with a damaged steel lattice transmission mast, low city roofs and hills. Mast is ordinary thin radio lattice with no observation deck; absolutely no Namsan tower.

cheonan.brief: Cheonan urban edge: broad three-way road junction seen at a distance, aging apartment blocks, roadside low workshops, low hills, no sea.

pyeongtaek.brief: Pyeongtaek port logistics plain: dense sealed shipping-container stacks and immense harbor cranes, flat west-coast inlet, warehouses and very low horizon.

suwon.brief: Suwon: Korean Hwaseong-style low stone fortress walls and tiled gate pavilion integrated with worn city roofs, gentle inland hills, no Seoul Namsan tower.

seoul.brief: Seoul: recognizable Namsan hill and slender N Seoul observation tower, weathered dense city apartments across the broad Han River, broken bridge piers. Tower ONLY here, subdued not monumental.

lake.brief: Fictional quiet dam reservoir near southern inland hills: forested slopes reflected in still water, a tiny fishing shack and unoccupied moored skiff.

mall.brief: Fictional inland abandoned department store: broad windowless commercial block with faded blank facade, empty parking area and overgrown lots, low city and ridges beyond.

tower.brief: Fictional mountain transmission site: skeletal utilitarian radio mast with cross braces and small dishes on wooded ridge, concrete equipment shed. No observation deck, no Seoul landmark.

spring.brief: Fictional wooded inland hot spring: low bathhouse roof and stone pools beside a mountain stream, faint local steam only, surrounding dense pines.

airfield.brief: Fictional disused military airfield: broad cracked runway, grass margins, two squat hardened hangars and low distant hills. No planes in flight, no combat.

solar.brief: Fictional inland solar farm: extensive ordered arrays of aged dark photovoltaic panels across low rolling fields, small maintenance shed, low distant tree line.

reststop.brief: Fictional sleeping Korean highway rest area: low service building, abandoned fuel canopy and broad empty parking lot, forest behind. Blank signboards without words.

tunnelbook.brief: Fictional book-storage tunnel in inland wooded hills: old railway tunnel portal, weathered brick utility annex and wooden book crates sheltered under a small awning outside.

ulsan.brief: Ulsan coastal heavy industry: vast idle shipyard gantry cranes, refinery pipes and cylindrical tanks by sheltered water, industrial hills beyond. No Seoul tower.

yeosu.brief: Yeosu south-coast harbor: hilly islands across sheltered seawater, compact coastal houses and small moored fishing boats, restrained warm harbor lamps.

suncheon.brief: Suncheon bay wetland: broad reed beds and winding tidal water channels, low rounded coastal hills in distance, no dense city or high-rise landmarks.

gwangju.brief: Gwangju Daein market district: layered low-rise Korean urban market roofs, weathered awnings and modest apartment blocks, broad mountain backdrop, no ocean.

damyang.brief: Damyang bamboo landscape: dense slender green-gray bamboo groves, low weathered tiled farm roofs in clearing, gentle wooded hill beyond.

mokpo.brief: Mokpo ferry terminal: aging waterfront passenger terminal and stationary ferries at docks, modest rocky coastal hill and clustered city roofs, distant islands.

andong.brief: Andong Hahoe village: low curved Korean tiled roofs and thatched houses within an inland river bend, pine-covered slope and broad sandy riverbank.

mungyeong.brief: Mungyeong Saejae: old low Korean stone gateway with tiled pavilion between steep forested mountain slopes, narrow valley and mature pines.

danyang.brief: Danyang river landscape: pale layered limestone cliffs above a winding inland river, low riverside town roofs and forested ridges.

wonju.brief: Wonju beneath Chiaksan: imposing layered forested ridges enclosing a weathered low town and patches of farmland; inland, no coast.

daegwallyeong.brief: Daegwallyeong high pass: rolling upland meadows and conifer ridges with several slender distant wind turbines, few buildings, cool subdued plateau.

gangneung.brief: Gangneung Gyeongpo coastal plain: broad open East Sea horizon, pale narrow beach and maritime pines with a few low worn coastal houses, no big harbor cranes.

sokcho.brief: Sokcho fishing harbor: modest fishing boats and breakwaters, compact seaside roofs, sharply layered Seorak mountain silhouettes on landward side.

icheon.brief: Icheon rural pottery district: low traditional wood-fired kiln roof and clay workshop sheds, stacked muted earthenware shapes, farmland and gentle hills, no giant chimney.

gyeongju.brief: Gyeongju royal tomb landscape: large smooth grass-covered burial mounds, low traditional roofs and scattered pines, distant mountains. Tombs are grassy rounded earth, no Egyptian pyramids.

pohang.brief: Pohang coastal steelworks: complex blast furnace towers, pipes, long steel mill halls and industrial waterfront with distant low hills, rusted muted metal.

sangju.brief: Sangju riverside agricultural plain: quiet river embankment, slender empty cycle path, fields and orderly poplar trees, low Korean town roofs far away.

gunsan.brief: Gunsan old inner harbor: aging low brick warehouses and rust-streaked moored fishing boats along tidal docks, flat estuary and low city roofs.

chungju.brief: Chungju lake: broad reservoir enclosed by forested ridges, small coves and tiny unoccupied fishing boat at a weathered jetty, no ocean port.

sejong.brief: Sejong administrative new town: long modern government-office blocks and repetitive apartment districts weathered by abandonment, broad planned boulevards, distant gentle hills.

lighthouse.brief: Fictional west-coast lighthouse: modest white cylindrical lighthouse with small lantern room on rocky coastal knoll, broad tidal sea and distant low islands. No people.

drivein.brief: Fictional abandoned drive-in cinema: broad blank outdoor projection screen on a steel frame, overgrown empty parking field, low projection booth and hills behind. Screen has no picture or text.

sunflower.brief: Fictional southern inland sunflower field: broad untended muted ochre sunflower rows, low farm shed and distant wooded hills; desaturated no vivid yellow cartoon.

maehwa.brief: Seomjin river plum village: pale flowering plum orchard terraces, small tiled farm houses and broad winding river between wooded hills, restrained desaturated blossoms.

mingyu_ridge.brief: Fictional inland wooded ridge with small weathered radio repeater array and concrete service hut, layered mountains, ordinary lattice poles not a landmark observation tower.

jaeyi_cache.brief: Fictional secluded inland storage yard: one corrugated-roof warehouse partly hidden by trees, stacked weathered crates beneath lean-to, low agricultural valley beyond.

cablecar.brief: Fictional forested mountain cable-car line: slender steel support pylons and two tiny unoccupied gondola cabins hanging above tree canopy, layered inland ridges.

filmset.brief: Fictional historical drama film set: compact row of weathered Korean tiled wooden houses and low courtyard walls, visibly simple timber backs at one edge, rural wooded hills.
